entries.name: Matshwane Vet Clinic
entries.duty: Emergency service available outside opening hours; call ahead. Home visits for vaccinations and consultations in and around Gaborone.
entries.note: Own site states an out-of-hours emergency service exists; no 24 h statement, no phone, address or hours published on the page opened. Needs phone from another own page in a later run.

duty_i18n.cs: Pohotovostní služba mimo otevírací dobu; před cestou zavolejte. Návštěvy doma kvůli očkování a konzultacím v Gaborone a okolí.
duty_i18n.sv: Akutjour finns utanför öppettiderna; ring innan du kommer. Hembesök för vaccinationer och konsultationer i och runt Gaborone.
duty_i18n.da: Akutvagt uden for åbningstid; ring på forhånd. Hjemmebesøg til vaccination og konsultationer i og omkring Gaborone.
duty_i18n.fi: Päivystys saatavilla aukioloaikojen ulkopuolella; soita etukäteen. Kotikäynnit rokotuksia ja vastaanottoja varten Gaboronessa ja sen ympäristössä.
duty_i18n.nb: Akuttjeneste tilgjengelig utenom åpningstid; ring på forhånd. Hjemmebesøk for vaksinasjon og konsultasjoner i og rundt Gaborone.

entries.name: Vet and Agric Consultants
entries.duty: Veterinary practice in Gaborone offering small animal, livestock and wildlife services; call the clinic for hours and emergencies.
entries.note: Own site (re-checked 2026-11-16) confirms Gaborone base and small animal services but gives no phone, address or 24 h statement. Branch locations (Block 3 Industrial, Phakalane) and the claim of a '24 hours emergency service' come only from the Sky Jobs employer profile (job board), so emergency_24h left false pending an own-site page. Phone seen masked (+267 3928689), not used. small_animals inferred from the clinic description, not stated on the own site.

duty_i18n.cs: Veterinární praxe v Gaborone nabízející služby pro malá zvířata, hospodářská zvířata a divokou zvěř; otevírací dobu a pohotovost zjistíte telefonicky na klinice.
duty_i18n.sv: Veterinärpraktik i Gaborone med tjänster för smådjur, lantbruksdjur och vilda djur; ring kliniken för öppettider och akutfall.
duty_i18n.da: Dyrlægepraksis i Gaborone med tilbud til små kæledyr, husdyr og vilde dyr; ring til klinikken for åbningstider og akutte tilfælde.
duty_i18n.fi: Eläinlääkärin vastaanotto Gaboronessa pieneläimille, tuotantoeläimille ja luonnonvaraisille eläimille; kysy aukioloajat ja päivystys soittamalla klinikalle.
duty_i18n.nb: Dyreklinikk i Gaborone med tjenester for smådyr, produksjonsdyr og viltlevende dyr; ring klinikken for åpningstider og nødtilfeller.

notes: Very thin run. Search surfaced almost no clinic own-sites for Botswana. No Botswana Veterinary Association, BUAN or Department of Veterinary Services page listing private small-animal clinics, duty rotas or an animal poison line was found. WebFetch refused (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED): https://www.vetagric.co.bw/ (root; the /index.php/home page was opened instead), https://familygems.co.bw/2017/11/28/owning-pet-botswana-medical-info/ (client_error). Not used (aggregator/directory only, not opened as entry source): localbotswana.com listings (Gaborone Veterinary Clinic +267 391 4121; Bhatanani Veterinary Clinic Francistown), medpages.info, directory.africa-business.com, goafricaonline (0 results). Nothing found for Francistown, Maun, Kasane, Palapye, Serowe private clinics. No 24 h clinic verified, no duty rota, no poison line. Government district veterinary offices (cms2.gov.bw PDF) are livestock/regulatory and not published. Needs own-site verification in a later run.
